caption:
Meet Wonda, the first AI agent built for content creation. Wonda makes it possible to create professional video and audio just by chatting with AI.

No editing skills? No problem. Wonda transforms your raw ideas, notes, or files into polished podcasts, ads, explainers, or product demos. Simply describe what you want — Wonda handles scripting, voices, editing, avatars, and even B-roll.

Wonda combines the best generative AI models into one creative workspace, so you can:
 • Create videos without complicated editing software
 • Turn documents, URLs, or concepts into ready-to-publish audio and video
 • Edit through natural conversation instead of timelines and tools
 • Collaborate with AI to refine your story until it’s perfect

🌍 Already trusted by creators and organizations worldwide — including Spotify, Amazon, and The World Bank — Wonda is redefining how content is made.
